title: A Wuhan court just made AI production costs a legal factor in copyright infringement cases
summary: A court in Wuhan, China has factored token usage and AI tool licensing fees into a copyright damages calculation for the first time. The ruling is part of China's broader push to build out copyright protections for AI-generated works.
